Rank 08 - Health

Doctor Chamber and Clinic Serial System

Patients want to know their serial. Chambers want fewer phone calls and a cleaner queue.

Calculate revenue Open overview

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee

8.2Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 700Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,200,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Private health facilities, doctor chambers, dental clinics, physiotherapy centers, and diagnostic collection points all deal with serial and waiting-room pressure.

Assistant writes names in notebook, patients call repeatedly, and serial disputes happen in waiting rooms.

Patients know their serial without crowding the desk.

Validation signals

  • Private health facility count is significant.
  • Waiting room pain is visible.
  • Chambers already use assistants.
  • SMS/WhatsApp reminders are natural.

MVP modules

  • Patient serial
  • Doctor schedule
  • SMS/WhatsApp token text
  • Visit status
  • Payment note
  • Basic patient history note
  • Daily chamber report

Do not build first

  • Do not build medical diagnosis.
  • Do not store sensitive records without consent.
  • Do not claim hospital-grade EMR.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Sensitive health data.
  • Doctor schedule changes.
  • Assistant resistance.
Mitigations
  • Collect minimal data first.
  • Fast reschedule controls.
  • Assistant-friendly UI.
